issues.evidence: Measured luma 16.5 (night hands insert, contrast 9.7) → 187.8 (white chatbot) across one cut inside the same scene; repeated at 00:31.07→00:31.83 (33.4 → 148.7) and 00:22.97 (33.3) after 00:16.5 (95.0). Overall luma spread SD 57.6, sat spread SD 36.4.
issues.suggested_action: Grade the illustrated UI into the night world: pull UI whites to ~70% (luma ≤ 140), tint highlights cool, so stock and UI sit within ±30 luma.

issues.evidence: Chatbot/Word/Excel look-alikes are neutral white (sat 12.9-23.1, luma ~200) with a hot centre glow, next to teal-shadowed stock (sat 63-118).
issues.suggested_action: Apply the night LUT to the UI layers too: lift blacks slightly, teal in shadows, gain down, add the same grain.

issues.evidence: Solution world saturation swings 12.7 (1:11.4 room thread) → 74-77 (1:18-1:31 split) → 14.2 (1:44) → 125.8 (1:55 evidence, flat saturated blue slab) → 90.6 (2:03) → 142.0 (2:11.6 candle room).
issues.suggested_action: Desaturate the blue slab at 1:55 (or remove it), and hold the product world at sat 35-60; pull the candle room to sat ~90.

issues.evidence: Head-in-hands plate: contrast 31, soft and lifted, with true-black frame edges around a milky grey-blue image.
issues.suggested_action: Set black point so the plate's shadows meet the frame's black; add contrast S-curve, keep skin at 55-65 IRE.

issues.evidence: Letterbox only on 6.4% of shots (96 rows at 0:11.1, 23 rows at 0:52.6), elsewhere full-frame 16:9.
issues.suggested_action: Either letterbox every live-action/in-world shot at 2.39:1 or none; never single shots.

issues.evidence: Mouse-click hand is pushed red-orange (sat 63, luma 18.8) and does not match the protagonist's teal-lit skin earlier.
issues.suggested_action: Pull hand to the skin line (hue ~20-25°), match warmth to the following candle shot.

issues.evidence: Grain/halation visible on stock only; UI, cards and end cards are clean digital.
issues.suggested_action: One finish pass over the whole timeline: fine grain, soft vignette, light halation on highlights.

issues.evidence: Sunrise (luma 64, sat 60) then cut to near-black text card (luma 23).
issues.suggested_action: Dissolve the tagline over the sunrise rather than cutting to black.

constraint_failures.rule: hard grade jump inside one scene
constraint_failures.evidence: luma 16.5 → 187.8, sat 36.1 → 23.1 in the same night sequence

constraint_failures.rule: UI frames left raw and white beside graded film
constraint_failures.evidence: teal stock luma 46.4/sat 118.2 cuts to white chatbot luma 202.9/sat 12.9

top_revision: Run the night-world LUT over the illustrated UI (whites down to ~140 luma, teal shadows, grain) so the problem half stops jumping 16→190 luma across cuts.

grade_recipe.night_problem_world: stock + UI: eq=gamma=0.95:contrast=1.08:brightness=-0.03, colorbalance=rs=-0.05:bs=0.08:rh=0.04:bh=-0.02, UI layers curves=all='0/0.04 0.5/0.42 1/0.72' (whites to ~72%), hue=s=0.85, noise=alls=6:allf=t, vignette=PI/5
grade_recipe.product_world: neutral-cool dark: eq=contrast=1.05:saturation=0.9, colorbalance=bs=0.04:bm=0.02, cap solid UI fills at sat 60 (desaturate the 1:55 blue slab to s=0.4), same grain alls=5, vignette=PI/6
grade_recipe.dawn_resolution: warm: colorbalance=rh=0.06:gh=0.02:bs=0.04, eq=saturation=0.8 (pull 2:11.6 from sat 142 to ~95), halation via gblur on highlights 0.15 mix, grain alls=6
